vya_text: dI0 - pUrvamuktaM nADIparIkShAdividhiriti anantaraM nADIparIkShAmAha - atheti - karasyeti | jIvasAkShiNI yA dhamanI sA karasyA~gguShThamUle ~astIti kriyApadaM yojyaM, tacceShTayA kRutvA kAyasya SarIrasya suKaM duHKaM ca j~jeyaM paNDitairiti SeShaH | dhamanIti | SabdavAhinI nADI dhamanI jIvanaM tanau#foot@-‘dhamanti pavanaM tanAvityato dhamanyaH’ pA0 |# ityato dhamanI jIvasAkShiNIti prANavAyoH sAkShiBUtA ata eva kutracijjIvanADIti kathitA | tathAhi -‘pradarSayeddoShanijasvarUpaM vyastaM samastaM yugalIkRutaSca | mUkasya mugdhasya vimohitasya dIpaH padArthAniva jIvanADI’ iti || lakShaNamapi ca - ‘asthnaH prakoShThabAhyasya madhyamAnAmikASritA | #foot@‘madhye kApi samASritA 'madhyakAmasamASritA’ pA0 |# jIvanADIti sA proktA nandinI tattvavedanA’ iti | tacceShTayA duHKamiti doShAdivaiShamyadharmaH | yataH ‘rogastu doShavaiShamyam’ ityAdivacanAt | paNDitairiti pravINaiH nADIgrahaNasya samayaviSeShaj~jairityarthaH | yataH - ‘sadyaH snAtasya Buktasya kShuttRuShNA ~a ~atapaSIlinaH | vyAyAmaSrAntadehasya samya~g nADI na budhyate’ iti || 1 ||
gU0 - karasyA~gguShThamUle yA dhamanI sA jIvasAkShiNI jIvo ~asti no veti bodhanI j~jeyA | budhaiH tacceShTayA mandasthiracalagAminyA kAyasya dehasya suKaM muKaM ca j~jeyam || 1 ||

pada: tRutIyo ~adhyAyaH | atha nADIparIkShAdividhiradhyAyaH | karasyA~gguShThamUle yA dhamanI jIvasAkShiNI | tacceShTayA suKaM duHKaM j~jeyaM kAyasya paNDitaiH || 1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM doShANAM nijasvarUpaceShTAmAha - nADIti | marutkope vAtaprakope jalaukAsarpayorgatiM gamanaM dhatte nADIti SeShaH | jalaukAsarpayostiryaggatirityaBiprAyaH#foot@‘sottAlagati’ pA0 |# tadvadatrA ~api | pittaprakopatastu kuli~ggAdInAM gatiM dhatte, kuli~ggo gRuhacaTakaH | kAkamaNDUkau prasiddhau eteShAmutplavanagatirityarthaH#foot@-‘pyartha’ pA0 |# | eke kuli~ggasthAne kalApIti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | kalApI mayUraH | SleShmaprakopAt haMsapArAvatagatiM dhatte | atrApi nADIti saMbadhyate | etena mandagativAhinI BavatItyaBiprAyaH | yato haMsapArAvatayorapi mandagatiH syAt || 2 ||
gU0 - marutkope sati nADI jalaukAsarpayorgatiM gamanaM dhatte | nADI pittasya kopataH kuli~ggakAkamaNDUkagatiM dhatte | kuli~ggo gRuhacaTakaH haMsapArAvatagatiM SleShmaprakopataH dhatte ||

pada: nADI dhatte marutkope jalaukAsarpayorgatim | kuli~ggakAkamaNDUkagatiM pittasya kopataH || 2 || haMsapArAvatagatiM dhatte SleShmaprakopataH |

gU0-nADI sannipAtataH tridoShaprakopataH lAvatittiravartikAnAM gamanaM dhatte | natvekasya jantorgatyA nAmnAM prakupitasya doShasya bodho Bavedato dvitrijantUnAM gatiH darSitA yathA vikRutimApanno vAyuH sarpagatiM dhatte | sAmyaM gato vAyuH jalaukAgatiM dhatte evamanye ~api j~jeyAH ||3|| dvidoShakopataH kadAcinmandagamanA kadAcidvegavAhinI j~jeyA ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnImasAdhyAyA lakShaNamAha - hantIti | sthAnavicyutA svasthAnAccalitA nADIti SeShaH | hantIti Aturamiti SeShaH | yA sthitvA sthitvA calati gacCati sApi prANanASinI j~jeyA | etena kadAcidvahati kadAcinna vahatItyaBiprAyaH | atikShINA ceti bisatantuvat, atiSItA ceti himasparSavat | asaMSayaM niScayena jIvitaM prANAn hanti nADIti SeShaH | cakArAt kuTilA cordhvAdhogamanaSIlApi prANanASinI boddhavyA | tathAcoktaM - ‘nADI madhyavahA~gguShThamUle yAtyarthamucCalet | SanairUrdhvArdhagamanA kuTilA hanti mAnavam ||’ iti || 4 || 5 ||

gU0 - sthAnavicyutA satI hanti | yA dhamanI sthitvA sthitvA calati sA prANanASinI smRutA kathitA | atikShINA SItA gacCatI satI prANino jIvitaM jIvanASaM asaMSayaM niHsaMdehena hanti dUrIkarotItyarthaH || 4 || 5 ||

pada: hanti ca sthAnavicyutA || 4 || sthitvA sthitvA calati yA sA smRutA prANanASinI | atikShINA ca SItA ca jIvitaM hantyasaMSayam || 5 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha jvarAdInAM dhamanIlakShaNamAha -jvarakopeNeti | jvarakopeNa sAmAnyajvarasya prakopeNa kRutvA dhamanI nADI soShNA uShNayuktA Bavet | jvarasyoShNAtmakatvAnna kevalaM soShNA vegavatI Bavet | jvarasya dehendriyamanaHsantApitatvAt | kAmakrodhAdapi vegavahA vegayuktA anauShNyena jvaravadBinnA | kAmo ~aBimatakAminyAdyaprAptiH, krodho hiMsAtmakAdirUpaH, cintABayapluteti cintABayayuktA nADI kShINA susUkShmA j~jeyA | cintA cittodvegarUpA, BayaM SatrupraBRutInAm | eke cintABayaSramAditi paThanti | cintABayaSramAnnADI kShINA susUkShmA j~jeyA | cintA mAnasodvegarUpA j~jeyA | tatra SramAd glAneH mandAgneH kShINadhAtoSca puruShasya nADI mandatarA Bavet, atyarthaM mandagatirityarthaH | asRukpUrNA rudhiraprakopAt pUritA nADI koShNA gurvI ca Bavet | koShNA IShaduShNA gurvI gurutarA pAShANavadityarthaH | eke soShNeti paThanti | sAmA AmayuktA nADI garIyasI syAt atyarthaM gurvI BavatIti BAvaH | Amena saha vartata iti sAmA, Amo ~aparipakvarasaH | tadyathA - ‘jaTharAnaladaurbalyAdavipakvastu yo rasaH | sa AmasaMj~jako dehe sarvadoShaprakopakaH’ iti | athavA AmagrahaNena AmAditrayamannajamajIrNaM gRuhyate tena tairyuktetyarthaH | tatra AmaM vidagdhaM viShTabdhaM ceti | eke sAmA garIyasIti paThanti | Amena saha vartata iti sAmA | te ca doShadUShyatAdayaH | yataH ‘Amena tena saMpRuktA doShA dUShyASca dUShitAH | sAmA ityupadiSyante ye ca rogAstadudBavAH’ iti | etena kimuktaM Bavati sAmadoShAt sAmadUShyAt sAmadUShitAt sAmarogAcceti | dUShyA rasAdayo dhAtavaH | dUShitAni malamUtrapraBRutIni | dIptAgneH prabalAgneH puruShasya laGvI vegavatI ca vahati | laGvI tUlavat saiva vegayuktA j~jeyA natu pUrvoktA | suKitasya svasthasya sthirA prakRutisthA BavatItyarthaH | na kevalaM svasthA tathA balavatI balayuktA na kShINetyaBiprAyaH | kShudhitasya buBukShitasyApi capalA ca~jcalA na mandetyarthaH | etena prakRutisthitAgniriti BAvaH | tRuptasya BojanAdinA santuShTasya puruShasya sthirA niScalaiva||6-8|| iti nADIparIkShA ||

gU0- sA dhamanI nADI jvarakopeNa jvarAdhikyena soShNA atyuShNA satI vegavatI Bavet kAmAt krodhAcca vegavahA syAt cintABayAplutA satI kShINA BavedityarthaH | atiSayena mandA mandatarA asRukpUrNA nADI koShNA IShaduShNA satI gurvI calet | koShNA IShaduShNA gurvI alpagariShThA sAmA AmayuktA nADI garIyasI Bavet | atiSayena gariShThA garIyasI | dIptAgneH puruShasya nADI laGvI vahati | tathA dIptAgneH puMsaH laGvI matA smRutA | suKino rogarahitasya puMsaH sthirA j~jeyA tathA balavatI smRutA | kShudhitasya puMsaH nADI capalA syAt | tRuptasya kRutaBojanasya puMsaH nADI sthirA vahati | anyAnyapi nADIparIkShAsthAnAnyAha granthAntarAt - `pAdayornADikAsthAnaM gulPasyAdho ~a~ggulatrayam | kaNThamUle~ggulidvandve nAsAmUle~ggulAdhikam| narasyA~gguShThamUle ca nADI caturthikA matA | sthAnAnyetAni nADInAM tAsu prANo vyavasthitaH’| karasya nADI sadaivAvalokanIyA anyA yAstisro nADyaH maraNasamaye ~avalokanIyA nAnyatra | anyatra karasyAvalokanIyeti | sadyaHsnAtasya Buktasya kShuttRuShAtapaSIlinaH | vyAyAmaSrAntadehasya samya~gnADI na budhyate | BAraprahAramUrcCABayaSokapramuKakAraNAnnADI saMmUrcCitApi bADhaM punarapi jIvanaM laBate || 6-8 || iti nADIparIkShA ||

pada: jvarakopeNa dhamanI soShNA vegavatI Bavet | kAmakrodhAdvegavahA kShINA cintABayaplutA || 6 || mandAgneH kShINadhAtoSca nADI mandatarA Bavet | asRukpUrNA BavetkoShNA gurvI sAmA garIyasI || 7 || laGvI vahati dIptAgnestathA vegavatI matA | suKitasya sthirA j~jeyA tathA balavatI smRutA || 8 || capalA kShudhitasyApi tRuptasya vahati sthirA |

vya_text: dI0 - pUrvamuktamAdigrahaNAt dUtasvapnAdInAM lakShaNakathanam | atha dUtalakShaNAnyAha --dUtA iti | evaMvidhA dUtA yadA BiShajaM vaidyaM prAptAstadA rogiNa Aturasya suKahetave BavantItyadhyAhAryam | vaidyAhvAnAya praSnAya AgatAH puruShA dUtAH kIdRuSAstAnAha - svajAtaya iti | svasyAM jAtau svagotre vA jAtAH svajAtayaH | eke ‘sajAtaya' iti paThanti tatra sapakShA ityarthaH | yaduktaM ‘pAShaNDASramavarNAnAM sapakShAH karmasiddhaye | ta eva viparItAH syurdUtAH karmavipattaye' iti | avya~ggA iti | vya~ggA hastAvayavahInAH na vya~ggA avya~ggAH | paTava iti pravINAH | etena vicitrakAlaj~jAH kathitAH | nirmalAmbarA iti SuBravastradhAriNaH, tena raktakRuShNavastrAdirahitA ityarthaH | suKina iti adInAH | aSvavRuShArUDhA iti aSvArUDhA vRuShArUDhASca | AsamantAt kAreNa rUDhAH iti yadgrahaNaM tanmahiShoShTraKarAdiyAnaniShedhArtham | SuBrapuShpaPalairyutA iti SvetapuShpaireBiH sAraPalaiSca saMyuktA ityaBiprAyaH | etena raktapItakRuShNAdiBiH sAraPalarahitA ityarthaH | yata evaMvidhAni puShpaPalAnyama~ggalAni Bavanti | tathAcoktam ‘tailakardamadigdhA~ggA raktasraganulepanAH | PalaM pakvamasAraM vA gRuhItvA ~anyacca tadvidham | vaidyaM ya upasarpanti dUtAste cApi garhitAH’ iti | sujAtaya iti SoBanA jAtiryeShAM te tathAvidhAH | etenAnyajAtijanitA niShiddhAH | pApakRudgarBotpattirahitA ityarthaH | yadvA vij~jAtajAtaya iti piNDArthaH | suceShTASceti ceShTAtra kAyakRuto vyApAraH SoBanavyApAra ityaBiprAyaH | SoBanagrahaNaM duSceShTitavyavacCedArtham | tathAhyuktaM 'CindantastRuNakAShThAni spRuSanto nAsikAM stanam | vastrAntAnAmikAkeSanaKaromadRuSaspRuSaH | sroto ~avarodhahRudgaNDamUrdhoraHkukShipANayaH | kapAlopala- BasmAsthituShA~ggArakarASca ye | viliKanto mahIM ki~jcinmu~jcanto loShTaBedinaH |‘ ityAdi duSceShTitA darSitAH | suceShTASceti cakAragrahaNAt sudarSanAH suveShA api gRuhyante anyathA garhitAH syuH | tathAhi - 'napuMsakaH strIbahavo naikakAryA asUyakAH | pASadaNDAyudhadharAH prAptA vA syuH paraMparA | ArdrajIrNApasavyaikamalinoddhatavAsasaH | nyUnAdhikA~ggA udvignA vikRutA raudrarUpiNaH | vaidyaM ya upasarpanti dUtAste cApi garhitAH' | sajIvadiSi sa~ggatA iti jIvanena prANAnilena saha yA dik nADI tasyAM sa~ggatAH prAptA ityarthaH | tathAca - 'yasyAM prANamarudvAti sA nADI jIvasaMyutA’ iti | nADI cAtra nAsAsaMbandhinI j~jeyA | yadvA - jIvena saha vartata iti yA dik diSA tasyAmityArthaH | tena yAmyadikrahitadiSAyAH prAptA iti tAtparyArthaH | yato yAmyadik niShiddhA | tathAhi - 'yAmyAM diSaM prA~jjalayo viShamaikapadasthitAH | vaidyaM ya upasarpanti dUtAste cApi garhitAH’ iti | samaye prAptA iti samaye SuBavelAtithinakShatrAdiyukte kAle anyathA aSuBakarA iti BAvaH | taduktam - ‘vaidyasya paitrye daive vA kArye cotpAtadarSane | madhyAhne cArdharAtre vA sandhyayoH kRuttikAsu ca || ArdrASleShAmaGAmUlapUrvAsu BaraNIShu ca | caturthyAM vA navamyAM vA ShaShThayAM saMdhidineShu ca || dakShiNABimuKaM deSe tvaSucau vA hutASanam | jvalayantaM pacantaM vA krUrakarmaNi codyatam|| nagnaM BUmau SayAnaM vA vegotsargeShu vA ~aSucim| prakIrNakeSamaByaktaM svinnaM viklavameva ca | vaidyaM ya upasarpanti dUtAste cApi garhitAH’ iti ||9||1 0||

gU0 - karmaNaH samaye snAnABya~ggAdirahitakAle yasyAM prANamarudvAti sA nADI jIvasaMyutA candrasUryasthAne yayordvayornADyormadhye yasyAM nADyAM prANamarudvAti gandhagrahaNAdhikArI BUtvA saMcArI sA nADI jIvasaMyutA vAcyA tasyA~ggasthaH pRucCako yadA pRucCati tadA sa rogI jIvati anyathA mriyate || anyatrApyuktaM - 'candrasthAne yadA vAyuH sUryasthAne ca pRucCakaH | tadA na jIvati rogI yadi vaidyaSatairvRutaH’ | etatpUrvoktasya sa jIvasyA~ggasya vyAKyAtam | iti dUtalakShaNAni || 9 || 10 ||

pada: dUtAH svajAtayo ~avya~ggAH paTavo nirmalAmbarAH | suKino ~aSvavRuShArUDhAH SuBrapuShpaPalairyutAH || 9 || sujAtayaH suceShTASca sajIvadiSi saMSritAH | BiShajaM samaye prAptA rogiNaH suKahetave || 10 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM gacCato dUtasya SakunAnyAha --. vaidyAhvAnAyeti | rogiNa Aturasya kRute nimitte vaidyAhvAnAya gacCato dUtasya saumyaSakunaM BerImRuda~ggAdi na SoBanamityarthaH | pradIptamasaumyaM suKAvahaM Bavati | gacCata iti mArge calitasya | etena viparItaSakunAnyatra SuBakArANi boddhavyAni | uktaM ca jyotiHSAstre - `sadyo raNe karmaNi ca praveSe Sukle gRuhe naShTavilokane ca | vyAdhau ca nadyuttaraNe BayArte SastaH prayANAdviparItaBAvaH ||? iti dUtaSakunalakShaNAni saMpUrNAni || idAnIM gacCato vaidyasyApi SakunAni darSayannAha - cikitsAmiti | rogiNa Aturasya cikitsAM rogApanayanaM karma kartuM gacCato mArge cAlitasya BiShajo vaidyasya yAtreyaM saumyaSakunaM proktamidaM SuBaM kathitaM dIptamaSuBamaSakunaM na SoBanamityarthaH | yAtreyaM yAtrAyogyaM yathA - BerImRuda~ggamRudumardalaSa~gKaveNuvedadhvanirmadhurama~ggalagItaGoShAH | putrAnvitA ca yuvatiH suraBiH savatsA dhautAmbaraSca rajako ~aBimuKaH praSastaH’ | anyacca -‘BRu~ggArA~jjanavardhamAnamakulAbaddhaikapaSvAmiShaSa~gKakShIranRupAnnapUrNakalaSacCatrANi siddhArthakAH | vINAketanamIna pa~gkajadadhikShaudrAjyagorocanAH, kanyASa~gKasitekShuvastrasumanoviprASca ratnAni ca’ iti | dIptamityatrAtreyaM tadyathA ‘gamanaM dakShiNe vAmAnna SastaM SvasRugAlayoH | vAmaM nakulacAShANAM noBayaM SaSasarpayoH || BAsakauSikayoScaiva na praSastaM kiloBayam | darSanaM ca rutaM cApi na godhAkRukalAsayoH || kulatthatilakArpAsatuShapAShANaBasmanAm | pAtraM neShTaM tathA ~a~ggAratailakardamapUritam || prasannetaramadyAnAM pUrNaM vA raktasarShapaiH | SavakAShThapalASAnAM SuShkANAM pathi sa~ggamAH | neShyanti patitAntasthadInAndharipavastathA’ iti || 11 || 12 ||

gU0 - AturamupakramamANena BiShajA AyurevAdau parIkShaNIyam | satyAyuShi dhRutyagnivayodehabalasatvasAtmya- prakRutiBeShajadeSAn parIkShayet | tatra pANipAdapArSvapRuShThastanAgradarSanavadanaskandhalalATadIrGAMgulipUrvocCvAsa- prekShaNabAhuvistIrNaBUstanAntaroraHskandhahRujja~gGAmeDhragrIvAgamBIrasatvasvaranABistanamupacitamahAromaSakarNapaScAnmaNikatAnuliptamUrdhAnupUrvyAviSuShyamANaSarIraM paScAcCuShyamANahRudayaM puruShaM jAnIyAt dIrGAyuH Kalviti tamekAntenopakramet | eBirlakShaNairviparItairalpamiSritairmadhyamAyuriti | vyAdhayastu trividhAH sAdhyAH, yApyAH, pratyAKyeyASca, taddRuShTvA karma kArayet | prAgaBihitA RutavaH ‘SIte SItapratIkAramuShNe coShNanivAraNam | kuryAtkriyAM prAptakAlaM na hApayet’ | prAgaBihitogniScaturvidhaH viShamo vAtena, tIkShNaH pittena, mandaH SleShmaNA, samaH sarvasAmAnyAditi | yaH kadAcit samyak pacati kadAcit SUlAdhmAnAdInkaroti sa viShamaH | yaH gurvAdikamASu pacati sa tIkShNaH | yaH laGurapi na pacati sa mandaH | yaH kAlamannamupayuktaM pacati sa samaH | vayastu trividhaM bAlaM madhyaM vRuddhamiti | tatronaShoDaSavarShA bAlAH; te tridhA kShIrapAH, kShIrAnnAdA, annAdA, iti | teShu saMvatsaraparAH kShIrAdA dvivatsaraparAH kShIrAnnAdAH parato ~annAdA iti ShoDaSasaptatyorantaraM madhyaM vayaH; tasya vikalpo vRuddhiryauvanaM sampUrNatA hAniriti tatrAviMSateH vRuddhirAtriMSato yauvanamAcatvAriMSataH sarvadhAtvindriyabalavIryasaMpUrNatA ata UrdhvamaSIteH paraM hAniryAvatsaptatiriti saptatestUrdhvaM kShIyamANadhAtvindriyajIrNAgAramivABivRuShTaSItaM vRuShamAcakShate ‘bAlye vivardhate SleShmA madhyame pittameva tu | BUyiShThaM varddhate vAyurvRuddhastadvIkShya varjayet | agnikShAravirekaistu bAlavRuddhau vivarjayet| tatsAdhyeShu vikAreShu SuddhiM kuryAtkriyAM BiShak | dehaH sthUlaH kRuSo madhya iti prAgupadeSitaH | karShayedbRuMhayeccApi mahAsthUlakRuSau narau | rakShaNaM caiva madhyasya kurvIta satataM BiShak ||’ balameva pradhAnaM kecitkRuSA eva balavantaH sthUlA abalavantaH tasmAdbalaM parIkShayet | satvamAha - ‘satvavAn sahate sarvaM saMstaByAtmAnamAtmanA | rAjasastapyamAnAnyaiH sahate nAma tAmasaH’ | prakRutimagre vakShyAmaH | pUrvoktaM BeShajamAha - ‘bAlasya prathame mAsi deyA BeShajaraktikA’ ityAdi pUrvoktam | SamamAha yathAvahRudakanagorUpaH kaPamArutarogavAn evamanyepi j~jeyAH | evaM sarvaM j~jAtvA paScAnmArge SakunAni parIkShya tadA cikitsAM kurvanti | rogiNaH cikitsAM kartuM gacCataH BiShajaH yAtreyaM saumyaSakunaM SoBanaM proktaM dIptaM na | rogiNaH kRute vaidyAhvAnAya gacCato dUtasya saumyaSakunaM SuBaM na pradIptaM suKAvahamityarthaH | iti SakunaH ||11||12||

pada: vaidyAhvAnAya dUtasya gacCato rogiNaH kRute || 11 || na SuBaM saumyaSakunaM pradIptaM ca suKAvaham | cikitsAM rogiNaH kartuM gacCato BiShajaH SuBam || 12 || yAtreyaM saumyaSakunaM proktaM dIptaM na SoBanam |

vya_text: dI0 - atha kIdRuSo rogI cikitsyastaddarSayannAha - nijaprakRutIti | BiShajA vaidyena IdRuSo rogI cikitsyaH, cikitsA rogApanayanaM karma tadyogyo BavatItyaBiprAyaH | kIdRuSaH ? tamAha - nijaprakRutivarNAByAM yukta iti yAdRuSau yasya prakRutivarNau staH tAdRugByAmeva saMyukta ityarthaH | nanu keyaM prakRutiH ? katiBedA ? kiMkAraNaM vA asyA iti ? taducyate - keyaM prakRutiH svaBAva ityarthaH | sa cAbAlapravRuttA niShekAdvA vAtArabdhAdyA AprayANAdanuvartate | kati BedA iti | sapta prakRutayo Bavanti pRuthagdoShairdvandvaiH samastaiSca | kiMkAraNamiti tadAha suSrutaH ‘SukraSoNitasaMyoge yo BaveddoSha utkaTaH | prakRutirjAyate tena tasyA me lakShaNaM SRuNu' iti | sA hi prakRutirjAtyAdIn ShaDupAdhInapekShate | taduktaM carake ‘tatra prakRutirhi jAtiprasaktA kulaprasaktA ca deSAnupAtinIti ca kAlAnupAtinI ca vayo ~anupAtinI ca pratyAtmaniyatA ceti' | tatra jAtiprasaktA nAma tAsu tAsu manuShyAdijAtiShu te te karacaraNAdayaH svaBAvaviSeShAH, vacaneShu ca nAnAvidhA eva vyaktyAdayo dharmaviSeShAH, manasi ca dharmAdharmamaithunAhArapraBRutayo ~api#foot@nAsti ‘ka’ pustake |# BAvAH | kulaprasaktA nAma dvijakule tapaHpriyatAdayaH, kShatriyakule samarapriyatAdayo dharmaviSeShA Bavanti | deSAnupAtinI nAma lATakarNATAyanAdInAM kAye vAci manasi ca te te svaBAvaviSeShA Bavanti | kAlAnupAtinI nAma dehAdiShu daurbalyAdidainyaglAnyAdyapekShA | gadeShu ca doShAdyapekShaNIyam | vayonupAtinI nAma bAlyAdyavasthAsu kAlAdau maryAdAdayo dharmAH | pratyAtmaniyatA ceti Atmani niyatA pratipuruShaniyatetyarthaH | te punaH kAye vAci manasi ca svaBAvaviSeShAH prakRutipuruShaBedaBinnA dRuSyanta iti | kecittu pA~jcaBautikIM prakRutimAhuH | anye tu prakRutiM sattvarajastamomayImAhuH | pUrvamuktaH prakRutivarNAByAM yuktaH | atastAvat prakRutistu saMkShepeNoktA | idAnIM varNamAha - varNaSabdena praBA kathyate | saiva cCAyApyaBimatA | eteShAM medo ~apyastItyeke BAShante | sA yathA - ‘varNapraBAmiSritA yA CAyA sA parikIrtitA | varNamAkrAmati cCAyA praBA varNaprakASinI || AsannA lakShyate CAyA praBA dUrAttu lakShyate’ iti | na kevalaM varNapraBAcCAyAnAM lakShaNaBedaH, saMKyABedo ~apyasti | sa yathA caturdhA varNAH - gauraH, kRuShNaH, SyAmaH, gauraSyAma iti | praBA saptavidhA - raktA, pItA, sitA, SyAvA, harit, pANDurA, asiteti || CAyApi pa~jcavidhA - snigdhA, vimalA, rUkShA, malinA, saMkShipteti | punaH kIdRuSo rogI cikitsyaH ? sattvena saMyuta iti | sattvaM tu vyasanAByudayakriyAsthAneShvapi karmakaram | yataH - ‘sattvavAn sahate sarvaM saMstaByAtmAnamAtmanA | rAjasastaByamAno ~anyaiH sahate naiva tAmasaH |’ iti suSrutaH | cakShuShopapannArthe pravarAvaramadhyamabalaM sattvaM trividham | eteShAM lakShaNaM na liKitamatra granthabAhulyAt | punaH kIdRuSaH ? vaidyaBakta iti vaidyAhlAdakaraH tadvAkyapAlane ~anurakta ityarthaH | yataH ‘ADhyo rogI BiShagvaSyo j~jApakaH sattvavAnapi’ iti vacanAt | punaH kathamBUtaH ? jitendriyo jitendriyaviShayaH, viShayAstu srakcandanavanitAdayaH | AturalakShaNam || 13 ||

gU0 - BiShajA IdRuSo rogI cikitsyaH | kiMviSiShTaH ? nijaprakRutivarNAByAM yuktaH | ( nanu yadvA kiM karoti na tu dahanaM sthAlI tandulAnodanaM kartuM kShamaH | tathAca SatapuShpA laGustIkShNA pittakRuddIpanI kaTurityAdivacanaM vahnimakurvANamapi AmaM pacati yathA sthAlIsthabahudugdhamuktikAcUrNaprathamajalayogAttandulAdikaM pacati natvagniM prajvAlayati ‘nAma puShpaM kaShAyoktaM rUkShaM labdhvAmapAcana’miti | tathAca ‘citrakaH kaTukaH pAke dIpanaH pAcano laGu’riti | kiMviSiShTaH ? satvena satvaguNena saMyutaH | punaH kiMviSiShTaH ? vaidyaBakto jitendriyaH | iti rogilakShaNam || 13 ||

pada: nijaprakRutivarNAByAM yuktaH sattvena saMyutaH || 13 || cikitsyo BiShajA rogI vaidyaBakto jitendriyaH |

vya_text: dI0 - athAnantaraM svapnAnyAha - svapneShviti | evaMvidhAn svapnAn strIpuruShayormadhye yaScaikaH paSyati sa eva yadi svastho ~anAturastarhi vyAdhiM laBate | yadA rogI paSyati tadA pa~jcatvaM maraNaM yAti prApnotItyarthaH | kIdRuSAn svapnAn ? tAnAha - nagnAn vastrAdirahitAn, muNDAniti muNDitAn, raktakRuShNAmbarAvRutAniti raktakRuShNavastraveShTitAnityarthaH | vya~ggAniti avayavAdirahitAn nAsAkartanAdiBirapi vya~ggAnityaBiprAyaH | vikRutAniti pa~ggukubjapraBRutIn, kRuShNAniti citrakalpitavat kArShNyABAsaH, sapASAniti pASayutAn, pASo dIrGaH paSUnAM bandhanarajjuH, badhnato niGnata iti niShThuraprahananakarmakAriNaH dakShiNAM diSamASritAniti | ete tu yadA dakShiNAM diSamASritA Bavanti tadA pracuramaniShTaM syAdityaBiprAyaH | tatra nair^^RutaM BAgadheyamiti vadanti | mahiShoShTraKarArUDhAniti mahiShAdivAhaneShu ArohitA ityarthaH | te tu yamasaMbandhinaScASuBakarA iti BAvaH || athAparANi duHsvapnAnyAha - adha iti | svapneShu yo ~api evaMvidho Bavati so ~apyaniShTaH kIdRuSastamAha - adho yo nipatatyuccAdityAdi | puruSha uccAdatyuccasthAnAdadho nimnasthAne nipatati sKalatItyarthaH | atyuccaM parvatAdikam | yo jale ~agnau vA vilIyate lIno Bavati | etena jale bruDati agnau pata~ggavat patatItyaBiprAyaH | yo ~api SvApadairhanyate SunaScaraNairAkRuShyata iti | eke svApadairiti paThanti, tatra svApadairnijabandhunASAdiBirupahanyate pIDyata ityarthaH | matsyAdyairiti gilito BakShito yo Bavet | AdigrahaNAnmakaranakraSiSumArapraBRutInAM grahaNam | yasya puruShasya ca netre vilIyete vilInatAM prApnuta iti | svapneShviti SeShaH | etena svacakShuShI vigalite paSyatItyarthaH | dIpo nirvANatAM vrajediti | etena kimuktam | yaH svapne ~apyakasmAddIpaM vinaShTaM paSyatItyaBiprAyaH | yaSca tailaM surAM vA pibet yaSca lohaM laBate tilAn vA laBate yaSca pakvAnnaM siddhamannaM laBate yaSca tadaSnAti BakShayati ca yo mAtaraM kuDyaM viSet mAturgRuhaM praviSatItyarthaH | eteShAM svapneShviti saMbandhaH | surAtra piShTamayI na tu madyaviSeShaH | svapne viSiShTamadyapAnaM praSastam | taduktaM ‘rudhiraM pibati svapne madyaM vApi kathaMcana | brAhmaNo laBate vidyAmitarastu dhanaM laBet’ iti | lohamityasya sthAne lauhamiti pAThAntaraM tatra lauhaM lohamayaM yaShTyAdi | vAgrahaNAt kArpAsapiNyAkalavaNAdInAM grahaNam | eteShAM lABe ~apyaniShTaM Bavati | eke viSet kuDyaM ca mAtaramityatra kuDyamutsa~ggaM vyAKyAnayanti | jananIM praviSennara iti paThanti kecit tatra mAturudare praviSatItyarthaH | tatra mAtrA saha SayanaM karotItyanye || idAnIM duHsvapnadarSanotpannAriShTanivRuttyarthaM ki~jcit pratIkAramAha - duHsvapnAnIti | evamAdIni pUrvoktanagnamuNDAdIni duHsvapnAni duHKotpAdakAni dRuShTvA svapnAvasthAyAmAlokya kasyacit purato na brUyAt na prakASayedityarthaH | paramuKenAniShTaSravaNaBayAt | tadanu kiM kuryAt? tadAha - snAnamiti | uShasi prAtareva snAnaM kuryAt hema tilAnayaSca dadyAt | hema suvarNam, tilAn kRuShNAn, ayo lohaH | punaH kiM kuryAdityAha - paThediti | devAnAM stotrANi devAnAM viShNupraBRutInAM stotrANi agnitrayAdIni | yathA - ‘agnitrayaM trINi ca puShkarANi nAmatrayaM trINi padAni viShNoH | rudrastrinetrastripathA ca ga~ggA etAni duHsvapnavinASanAni |’ iti | iti dinakRutyaM | rAtrAvapi devAlaye devamaNDapaM vaset | tatra jAgaraNaM kuryAditi keShA~jcinmatam | atha duHsvapnamupasaMharan PalamAha -kRutvaivamiti | evamuktaprakAreNa snAnadAnAdikaM karma kRutvA saMpAdya tridinaM dinatrayaM yathA syAt martyaH puruShaH duHsvapnAt duHKajanakanimittAt parimucyate suKI BavatItyarthaH || 14-21 ||

gU0 - svapneShu naGnato GnantaH strI vA pumAn yaH paSyati dakShiNAM diSaM ASritAn paSyati | yadA svasthaH paSyati tadA sa svasthaH vyAdhiM laBate, naro yaH striyaH puMsaH svapneShu naGnato GnantaH dakShiNAM diSaM ASritAn nagnAn paSyati, muNDAn paSyati, raktakRuShNAmbarAvRutAn paSyati, vya~ggAn paSyati, vikRutAn paSyati, kRuShNAn sapASAn paSyati, sAyudhAn paSyati, mahiShoShTraKarArUDhAn etAn yaH svasthaH paSyati cettadA vyAdhiM laBate | rogI paSyati cettadA pa~jcatAM maraNAvasthAM yAtItyarthaH | strIpuMsa ityatrAkArAntaH SabdaH, kutaH ‘acaturavicaturasucaturastrIpuMsa-’ ityAdyAH SabdA nipAtyante tasmAdakArAnto Bavatyeva | vya~ggAn pAdaKa~jjAn vikRutAn kutsitarUpAn kRuShNAn SyAmAn sapASAn bandharajjusahitAn | sugamamanyat | punarbahirnAyAti sa svasthaH dRuShTvA vyAdhiM laBate | rogI pa~jcatAM yAtIti sarvatrAnuSha~ggaH | yasya puMsaH svapneShu netre vilIyete BagnAyete, dIpaH nirvANatAM netrAdarSanAvasthAM vrajet prApnuyAt saH svasthaScet evaM paSyati rogI Bavet, rogI pa~jcatAM yAtItyarthaH | pumAn svapneShu tailaM pibet vA surAM pibet vA lohaM laBate vA kutrApi pakvAnnaM laBate vA tilAn laBate snAti vA mAnavaH vA kUpAn viSet punarbahirna yAti sa svasthaH evaM dRuShTvA vyAdhiM laBate, rogI pa~jcatAM yAtItyarthaH | AdIni prathamAni duHsvapnAni dRuShTvA mAnavaH kasyacinna kathayet | tarhi kiM kuryAt, uShasi snAnaM kRutvA ayo lohaM dadyAt hema tilAn dadyAt paScAddevAnAM stotrANi devAlaye paThet punA rAtrau tatraiva vaset martyaH tridinaM evaM kRutvA duHsvapnAtparimucyate mukto Bavati ||14-21||

pada: svapneShu nagnAnmuNDAMSca raktakRuShNAmbarAvRutAn || 14 || vya~ggAMSca vikRutAnkRuShNAnsapASAnsAyudhAnapi | badhnato niGnataScApi dakShiNAM diSamASritAn ||15|| mahiShoShTraKarArUDhAMstrIpuMso yastu paSyati | sa svastho laBate vyAdhiM rogI yAtyeva pa~jcatAm||16|| adho yo nipatatyuccAjjale ~agnau vA vilIyate | SvApadairhanyate yo ~api matsyAdyairgilito Bavet || 17|| yasya netre vilIyete dIpo nirvANatAM vrajet | tailaM surAM pibedvApi lohaM vA laBate tilAn ||18|| pakvAnnaM laBate ~aSnAti viSetkUpaM rasAtalam | sa svastho laBate rogaM rogI yAtyeva pa~jcatAm ||19|| duHsvapnAnevamAdIMSca dRuShTvA brUyAnna kasyacit | snAnaM kuryAduShasyeva dadyAddhematilAnapaH || 20 || paThetstotrANi devAnAM rAtrau devAlaye vaset | kRutvaivaM tridinaM martyo duHsvapnAtparimucyate || 21 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha duHsvapnAni pratipAdya saMprati praSastasvapnAni darSayannAha - svapneShviti | yaH puruShaH svapneShu surAdIn paSyet sa suKamApnuyAdityarthaH | surAnitIndrapraBRutidevAn, BUpAniti rAj~jaH, suhRudo mitrANi, dvijAn brAhmaNAn, ete tu jIvanta iti prakRutiprANayutAnityarthaH | tathAnyAnapi | gauH | samiddhAgniH prajvalitavahniH | tIrthAni prayAgAdIni || aparANyAha - tIrtveti | yaH puruShaH svapneShu evaMvidho Bavati sa suKI BavedityarthaH | kIdRuSastamAha - kaluShanIrANi sakardamapAnIyAni tIrtvA uttIrya sthitamiti BAvaH | SatrugaNAn ripusamUhAn jitvA Agata iti tAtparyArthaH | saudhagoSailAdInAruhya prApta iti BAvaH | saudho dhavalagRuhaH, gaurvRuShaBaH, SailaH parvataH, karI hastI, vAhAnaSvAdIn, kaluShanIrANIti bahuvacanena nadInadasamudrAdInAM grahaNam | taduktam ‘nadInadasamudrAMSca kShuBitAn kaluShodakAn | taret kalyANalABAya vyAdherapagamAya ca' iti || anyAnyapyAha - SuBreti | Aturo rogI SuBrapuShpAdIni prApya suKI BUyAdanAturaH syAdityarthaH | yadA svastho ~apIdRuSaH syAt tadA dhanamApnuyAditi BAvaH | SuBrapuShpANIti SuBrapuShpapraBRutIni, vAsAMsi cAtra SuBrANi j~jAtavyAni, mAMsamatra AmaM natu paripakvaM vakShyamANatvAt| PalAnIti AmrapraBRutIni || athetarANyAha - agamyeti | agamyAgamanaM anucitasthAnagamanaM, viShThAyAH purIShasya lepaH karacaraNAdiShu, ruditamiti rodanam | AtmanaH parasya vA | mRutirmaraNaM AmamAMsamityatra pare pakvamAMsASanamiti paThanti | etacca svapne dhanArogyAptaye dhanaprAptaye ArogyaprAptaye ca || jalauketi | jalaukAdayo yaM puruShaM daSanti BakShayanti svapneShviti SeShaH | sa yadA rogI Bavati tadA rogaH syAt | svasthopi dhanaM prApnotItyaBiprAyaH | jalaukA prasiddhA, BramarIti kRuShNavarNamadhumakShikABedaH, makShikASca svalpAH, sarpo ~ajagarapraBRutikaH | vAgrahaNAt varaTA-madhumakShikA-maSakAdInAM grahaNam || iti svapnalakShaNam || 22-26 || iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaSrIBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAM prathamaKaNDe nADIparIkShAdividhiradhyAyastRutIyaH ||
